subject: Decisions: sweep + service proposal shape
body:
Team,

Decisions from today's review, one week out from the sweep:

1. Sweep is confirmed for our cirrus-tpu week of 6/22 with the full 256-accelerator layout — Maren's job configs are done, and the neural comparison arms run alongside NEMO for the full matrix. Umar, please freeze the estimator configs by 6/18.
2. Service proposal shape, based on Umar's results: NEMO is the default predictor with per-feature reliability scores; the neural arms are documented but not proposed for serving — they don't win in the observation regime our users are actually in.
3. Kofi reviewed the WALS licensing question — attribution requirements only, no blocker.

Proposal draft to me by 7/1 for the 7/6 close. Nearly there.

Priya
